fact: The UN Somalia Joint Fund final report says over 22,000 properties are mapped, geo-referenced and interfaced in Garowe with a mobile money payment platform giving real-time payment tracking, with similar work in Baidoa and Gabiley, and that FMIS support is funded by the World Bank.
title: UN Somalia Joint Fund - Final Report (JPLG III project data, Annex VII)
publisher: UNDP Multi-Partner Trust Fund / UN Somalia Joint Fund
